backend_type.description: The type of monitoring backend (nagios, icinga, op5, centreon, checkmk, etc.)

server_url.description: The base URL of the monitoring server web interface.

username.description: Username used to authenticate with the monitoring server.

password.description: Password used to authenticate with the monitoring server.

check_interval.description: Time in seconds between status checks.

notifications_enabled.description: Whether to enable desktop/system notifications for status changes.

icon_theme.description: Name of the icon theme to use for the system tray icon.

language.description: Language code for the user interface.

check_updates.description: Whether to check for new versions of Nagstamon automatically.

monitor_name.description: Unique name/identifier for this specific monitoring instance configuration.

display_name.description: Human-readable name displayed in the application.

server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the monitoring server.

server_port.description: Network port of the monitoring server.

base_url.description: Base path for the monitoring server's CGI or API interface.

auth_method.description: Authentication method used by the backend (cgi, xmlrpc, api, etc.).
